Course-specific reading. Shared links also live under [References](../../references/index.qmd).

## Primary course links

- NPTEL: [106108841 — Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning](https://nptel.ac.in/courses/106108841)
- YouTube playlist: [MFML (Prathosh A.P.)](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLgMDNELGJ1Cay-Q9Cn8KcpUcC58NDWuiu)
- Instructor: [Dr. Prathosh A.P.](https://prathosh.in/)

## Prerequisites / refreshers

| Topic | Resource |
|-------|----------|
| Probability basics | Blitzstein & Hwang, *Introduction to Probability* (free online) |
| Probability (measure-minded) | Bertsekas & Tsitsiklis, *Introduction to Probability* |
| Linear algebra refresh | Deisenroth et al., *Mathematics for Machine Learning* (free PDF) |

## Core ML theory texts (use as needed by lecture)

| Topic | Resource |
|-------|----------|
| Classical probabilistic ML | Bishop, *Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning* |
| Modern probabilistic ML | Murphy, *Probabilistic Machine Learning* |
| Statistical learning | Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman, *Elements of Statistical Learning* (free PDF) |
| Information theory (entropy, KL) | Cover & Thomas, *Elements of Information Theory* |
| Deep learning | Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville, *Deep Learning* |

## Note on math in this site

All notes use `$...$` / `$$...$$` only (not `\\(...\\)`), so symbols like $\Omega$ render correctly with MathJax.
